newsitem.title: TAJIKISTAN: Russian border guards kill two on Afghan border.
newsitem.headline: Russian border guards kill two on Afghan border.

text.p: Russian border guards shot dead two armed men trying to cross into Tajikistan from neighboring Afghanistan, a spokesman for the Russian border troops in Tajikistan said on Wednesday.

The spokesman in the Tajik capital Dushanbe said the two had been trying to cross the Pyandzh river, which marks part of the border in the south of the country, on Tuesday. They were backed by gunfire from Afghan territory.
Around 20,000 Russian peacekeepers and border guards serve in Tajikistan, viewing themselves as a shield against militant Islam spreading northwards from Afghanistan.

The ceasefire agreed last year between Tajikistan's secular government and a united Islamist opposition is often disturbed by maverick armed bands and drug traders operating out of their bases in Afghanistan.

On Tuesday Tajikistan's senior security officials -- worried by reports that the purist Islamist Taleban militia was advancing in northern Afghanistan -- held an urgent meeting to work out measures to reinforce the border and prevent a possible influx of refugees from Afghanistan.
